title: Hide past bookings by default in the admin List view, with a toggle to reveal them
tech: React + TypeScript frontend only -- no backend or API change needed
keyConstraints: Confirmed by reading AdminDashboard.tsx and frontend/src/api/types.ts: the List view's GET /admin/bookings call (getAdminBookings(statusFilter)) already fetches the full matching set for the selected status filter every time, with no date-range restriction on either the request or the response -- so today a masseur with months of history sees every past booking mixed in with upcoming ones, and this can be fixed purely client-side with no new fetch volume and no backend change. AdminBooking (frontend/src/api/types.ts) already carries both the backend-formatted display strings (start_at_local, end_at_local) AND the raw UTC ISO instants (start_at, end_at) -- use the raw start_at/end_at for the past/upcoming comparison, never the *_local strings (those are formatted for display, not safe to parse/compare). Add a second, independent boolean toggle (e.g. showPast, default false) alongside the existing statusFilter state in AdminDashboard.tsx -- do not fold this into or replace STATUS_FILTERS; the two filters are orthogonal (e.g. a masseur should be able to view confirmed+upcoming, or confirmed+including-past). Definition of 'past': a booking counts as past only once it has FULLY ENDED, i.e. end_at < now -- NOT start_at < now -- so a booking currently in progress (started but not yet ended) still shows by default; use end_at for the comparison. Toggle should follow the existing aria-pressed button pattern already used for viewMode and statusFilter in this file (see the Palvelut/Suodata button pattern) rather than introducing a new UI pattern, and its label must be in Finnish (this codebase completed a full Finnish-translation pass across all admin pages in task 031 -- e.g. something like 'Näytä menneet varaukset' toggled to 'Piilota menneet varaukset' when active, but Ville should review the exact wording for naturalness). When the filtered (upcoming-only) list is empty but past bookings exist under the current status filter, consider whether the existing empty-state message ('Ei varauksia tässä näkymässä.') is still accurate/helpful or whether it should hint that past bookings are hidden -- Architect should decide and document the reasoning either way. This is purely a client-side filter over the already-fetched bookings array; do not add pagination, a date-range query param, or any other backend/API change -- that would be new scope beyond what this task asks for.
description: In the admin dashboard's List view, hide bookings that have already fully ended by default, and add a clearly-visible toggle button that reveals them again -- so the masseur's day-to-day list of upcoming appointments isn't cluttered with growing booking history, while still making that history easy to pull up on demand.
acceptanceCriteria: By default (on load and whenever statusFilter changes), the List view shows only bookings whose end_at is in the future (or in progress) -- bookings that have already ended are hidden

A toggle button, following the existing aria-pressed pattern used elsewhere in this file, lets the masseur reveal past bookings; toggling it shows the full matching set (past + upcoming) for the current statusFilter, toggling it off returns to upcoming-only

The past/upcoming toggle and the existing status filter (pending/confirmed/cancelled/all) compose correctly and independently -- e.g. switching statusFilter while showPast is on keeps showing past+upcoming for the new status, without needing to re-toggle
The comparison uses the raw start_at/end_at ISO fields (not start_at_local/end_at_local) and end_at specifically (a booking in progress -- started but not yet ended -- is never hidden as 'past')
All new/changed UI text is natural Finnish, consistent with task 031's translation

New test coverage in AdminDashboard.test.tsx: past bookings hidden by default, toggle reveals them, toggle composes correctly with at least one non-default statusFilter value, and an in-progress booking (start_at in the past, end_at in the future) is never hidden
No regression to existing AdminDashboard tests (status filter switching, Confirm/Decline/Cancel actions, view-mode switching) -- run the full existing suite, not just an assumed-safe subset
npm test, npm run build, npm run lint, and tsc --noEmit all pass in frontend/ (backend should be unaffected since no backend files change)
relevantFilePaths: frontend/src/api/types.ts (AdminBooking -- read-only reference, confirms start_at/end_at raw ISO fields already exist)
securityConsiderations: None -- purely client-side display filtering over data already returned by the existing authenticated GET /admin/bookings endpoint; no new data exposure (past bookings are already sent to the client today, just always rendered), no new API surface.
